zones.title: Receive
zones.body: One turn per call: sessionId, transcript, ASR confidence.

zones.title: Load state
zones.body: Prompts (goals, rules, spoken lines), the session row and the market row are the only state the model sees.

zones.title: Gates
zones.body: YesNoGate: a deterministic no in IDENTIFY (a customer on file says it is not them), a yes or no in CONSENT, DEALER, CONFIRM and CONFIRM_CANCEL, a spoken journey in NEED (cancel, reschedule, callback, self-service), a chosen service in SERVICES and a date in LOOKUP move the state before the model runs, so a small model cannot loop on a confirmed question or forget a tool call.

zones.title: Prefetch and prompt
zones.body: The sub-workflow a gate implies runs here, deterministically: the appointment search on cancel or reschedule, the reservation on dealer agreed, the slot search on services chosen or a new date, the cancel, book or move on the caller's yes. Its result goes into the facts and the model reads it out instead of calling the tool. Then the system prompt is composed.

zones.title: Reason
zones.body: The agent has nine tools (PIN verification, then one per joint-scope step), Postgres memory and a structured parser with auto-fix.

zones.title: Guards 1: gates
zones.body: ClampOutput: only values the schema allows, only a state transition the table allows (illegal_transition), a journey intent sticks for the call. Then each rule is an If (the condition) and an Edit Fields (what it changes). Gates: a deterministic yes or no in IDENTIFY and CONSENT wins over the model.

zones.title: Guards 2: caller, identification and outcomes
zones.body: Caller asks for a person: handoff. Two failed PIN checks: handoff. A state beyond IDENTIFY before VerifyIdentity succeeded is forced back. OutcomeSync: a booking, move, cancellation or callback written by a tool forces its state. A booking, move or cancellation claim without a tool result is replaced by a question. Self-service instructions are read out verbatim.

zones.title: Guards 3: reply and end
zones.body: Empty or over-long replies are fixed. A handoff always speaks the market's handover line. No end before a journey outcome (BOOKED, MOVED, CANCELLED, CALLBACK_LOGGED, SELF_SERVICE) or WRAPUP.

zones.title: Handoff
zones.body: A model failure answers with a fixed apology and PLATFORM_ERROR. Any handoff builds the Refer-To through AR-14.

zones.title: Respond
zones.body: Session update, event row, the reply the gateway speaks.

panels.title: AR-02 Dialogue turn
panels.body: The brain. State lives in ar_sessions; the system prompt is rebuilt every turn. Guards after the model: no booking claim without a confirmation code, no slot that was not offered, no end before WRAPUP.

panels.title: Tools
panels.body: VerifyIdentity, FindDealers, CreateReservation, FindSlots, BookAppointment, FindAppointment, CancelAppointment, MoveAppointment, RequestCallback. sessionId is plumbed, never a model parameter. Handoff is not a tool: it is a deterministic consequence of action=handoff.
